qa.answer: GWM Thailand offers 5 sub-brands: **TANK** (rugged SUVs), **ORA** (EV/hybrid city cars), **HAVAL** (family SUVs), **POER** (pickups) and **WEY** (luxury). Popular models: **ORA 5 EV** (฿649,000), **ORA 5 HEV** (฿709,000), **TANK 300 LIMITED** (฿1,349,000), **TANK 500**, **HAVAL H6**, **POER SAHAR**, **WEY G9** (฿2,349,000). Want details on any model?

links.label: ดูรถทุกรุ่น / All models

qa.answer: **ORA 5** is GWM's stylish city car, available as **ORA 5 EV** (full electric, from **฿649,000**) and **ORA 5 HEV** (hybrid, from **฿709,000**). Great for urban driving with modern tech.

The **TANK** series are rugged off-road SUVs: **TANK 300** (incl. DIESEL and the **LIMITED** at ฿1,349,000) and the larger **TANK 500** (petrol & diesel). Built for adventure with serious 4WD capability.
**HAVAL** family SUVs: the **HAVAL H6** (available HEV/PHEV) and the compact **HAVAL JOLION**. Comfortable, tech-rich SUVs for everyday family use.
**POER SAHAR** is GWM's pickup truck — capable for both work and lifestyle, available in single/double cab and diesel options.
**WEY G9** is GWM's premium PHEV MPV — a spacious luxury people-mover, priced from **฿2,349,000**.

Starting prices: **ORA 5 EV ฿649,000**, **ORA 5 HEV ฿709,000**, **TANK 300 LIMITED ฿1,349,000**, **WEY G9 ฿2,349,000**. TANK 500, HAVAL H6 and POER SAHAR prices vary by trim — please check the model page or a GWM Store for the latest on-road price.

links.label: ดูราคารถทุกรุ่น

qa.answer: You can book a **test drive (ทดลองขับ)** online — pick your model and preferred GWM Store, and a representative will confirm. Tell me which model you're interested in and I can point you to the booking page.

links.label: จองทดลองขับ / Test drive

qa.answer: GWM has **GWM Stores / showrooms (โชว์รูม)** across Thailand. Use the store locator on the website to find the nearest one, or call **02-668-8888** for help.

links.label: ค้นหาโชว์รูม / Find a store

qa.answer: GWM offers **financing / installment plans (การเงิน/ผ่อน)** with an online calculator to estimate monthly payments. Final terms are confirmed at a GWM Store. Want me to point you to the calculator?

links.label: คำนวณค่างวด

keywords: พลังงานใหม่
qa.answer: **Hi4** is GWM's new-energy intelligent 4WD hybrid technology, used across its xEV (HEV/PHEV/EV) lineup for better efficiency and performance.
The **My GWM** app (iOS & Android) lets owners manage their vehicle, book service, join the community and more. Download it from the App Store or Google Play.
GWM has a certified **used-car (รถมือสอง)** platform with inspected vehicles. Browse at usedcar.gwm.co.th.

links.label: รถมือสอง GWM

qa.answer: GWM offers **corporate / fleet (ลูกค้าองค์กร)** programs for businesses. Contact **02-668-8888** to discuss fleet pricing and support.
You can reach **GWM Thailand** at **02-668-8888**, via the **My GWM** app, or follow us on Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, X and **LINE (@gwmthailand)**.
